Subject: Proposed amendment — add capacity + indexed pricing

Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As discussed, we're drafting a concise amendment to your existing Order Form to: (1) add an extra 50k token-hours of Reserved Capacity for Q4 pilot; and (2) introduce an indexed pricing mechanism so fees can adapt modestly to GPU cost changes over time rather than a fixed annual escalation.

Attached: helixai_amendment_proposed_v1.pdf and a short redlines_proposal.docx that highlights the changed Order Form lines and the proposed SOW tweak for implementation window. Key asks on our side:
- Approval to increase the committed capacity on the existing order form (Exhibit A)
- Agreement on an indexing clause tied to a published compute index (we suggested GPU Spot Index) with advance notice before any change

Can you confirm procurement is comfortable reviewing this week? If helpful, we can put legal on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the wording.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@helixai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixai.com
Date: 2027-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment — add capacity + indexed pricing

Rishi —

Thanks for the draft. We like the idea of capacity for Q4 but procurement/corp counsel have two primary concerns with the current indexation language:
1) It reads like an automatic annual increase — we need a clear cap and a formula tied to a neutral, public index.
2) Any price change needs a 60-day notice and the ability for us to lock rates for existing committed capacity for at least 12 months.

Also, the SOW timing language around the implementation window needs to be explicit about milestones so our engineering team can plan. Can you circulate a redline that addresses: cap on indexing, 60-day notice, and milestone-based implementation?

Looping in our outside counsel (Samantha Yuen) who will review final legal language.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Procurement — HelixAI

On a separate note: do you have a single PDF that highlights just the price clause changes? That speeds review on our side.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Team —

Forwarding Jordan's procurement note. They want: a) cap on any indexation increase, b) 60-day notice, c) lock option for existing capacity for 12 months, and d) clearer SOW milestones.

Can legal propose alternative wording that preserves our ability to adjust unit economics to actual GPU market moves (we're trying to avoid a multi-year fixed discount) but gives a procurement-friendly cap and notice window?

If you can get a redline back by EOD tomorrow, I will share with Jordan and their counsel. Attached are the draft amendment and the isolated redline doc.

Thanks — Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Proposed amendment — HelixAI (legal redline suggestions)

Rishi / team —

Thanks for the context. Drafted comments below and attached legal_redline_amendment.docx with tracked changes. High-level suggestions:
- Replace unspecified "indexed pricing" with: "pricing adjustments shall be tied to the Redwood Compute Index (RCI) published monthly; adjustments shall not exceed 5% in any 12-month period and are subject to 60 days' prior written notice."
- Add an explicit "rate lock" clause: HelixAI may elect to lock existing committed capacity rates for up to 12 months from the amendment effective date; any subsequently added capacity will be subject to the then-applicable rates.
- Move the SOW milestone schedule into Exhibit B (Implementation Plan) with three measurable milestones and acceptance criteria; include an implementation holdback of 10% until final acceptance.
- Confirm SOC 2 reference and audit rights: we should preserve Redwood's standard audit window but provide evidence of SOC 2 Type II summary rather than full reports unless requested under NDA.

We limited the cap to 5%/yr to keep us commercially viable while allowing HelixAI predictability. If this cap is a hard blocker, we can discuss an alternative mechanism: CPI + compute-surcharge band (1–6%) with a negotiated collar.

Attaching legal_redline_amendment.docx for your review. If Rishi wants, Jonas and I can join the call with Helix counsel tomorrow at 10:30 PT.

—Monica
